messages.content: I can answer questions, search the web, open sites or apps, play music or video, generate text or images, write code, essays, emails, and help you plan ideas, Sir. Just tell me what you need.
Should I learn web development by python or AI first?

I’d start with web development in Python, Sir, because it gives you immediate, visual results, builds solid programming fundamentals, and familiarises you with the Python ecosystem you’ll later need for AI. The risk is you’ll postpone the math and theory essential for AI, so be prepared to study that afterwards.
how long will it practically take to complete free python course

Most free Python courses cover the basics in roughly 40‑60 hours, so at about ten hours a week you’ll finish in four to six weeks, Sir. Your exact time will depend on prior coding experience and how deeply you explore projects.
i want to build ai assistant who has strong thinking and decision making for which which level is needed for python

I’d aim for at least an intermediate level—confident with OOP, data structures, and core libraries like NumPy and pandas—then move to advanced when you start using PyTorch/TensorFlow and reinforcement‑learning frameworks. That foundation lets you build pipelines, fine‑tune models, and implement robust decision logic, while skipping fundamentals risks fragile code and debugging headaches, Sir.
